recipes.title: Choose the next tool
recipes.description: Choose among a small set of tools with explicit capabilities.
recipes.policy: Use the result as advice. Review missing or low-probability answers; the calling agent retains authority.

recipes.title: Review a proposed tool call
recipes.description: Classify a proposed tool call as clear or caution before anything runs.
recipes.policy: Advice only. A clear review is not permission to run the tool. Caution, a failed review, or an irreversible effect waits for a person. Set the probability and confidence cutoffs from your own labeled cases. This engine never executes the tool.

validation.note: This recipe has no attached held-out labeled quality evaluation. Check-helper smoke tests and Code Mode procedure measurements do not validate this recipe's prompts.
